draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.83, the 199th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 30th of 35 at WR. He went 129th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (199th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Published comparison: Dri Archer (entering NFL). Testing standouts: 20-yard shuttle (85th percentile), three-cone (90th percentile). College production: 1,190 receiving yards in 2020, 5th of 35 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2024. 36 career games and 1 starts over 4 completed seasons. Career-best season: 0 AV in 2021. Weak spots: team target share 0.2% (0th percentile), receiving yards 6 (3rd percentile).
